title: Bounty Overnight Weetbix
description:
9/10 – a Bounty for breakfast for under 500 calories.. win!
https://www.facebook.com/reel/2187967822142124
method: Crush 2 Weetbix into a container and pour over your choice of milk and mix until fully combined. Press everything down firmly to create the base.
Add 200g of coconut protein yoghurt and sprinkle over 10g of desiccated coconut.
Melt 10g of dark chocolate, then mix it with 25g of fat-free Greek yoghurt
Spread the chocolate mixture evenly over the coconut layer.
Top with half a sliced banana, if using, then pop the lid on and refrigerate overnight—or for at least 4 hours.
